quality_policy.preferred_publication_level: At least 3 of 6 papers target JCR Q1; every remainder targets at least JCR Q2
quality_policy.note: Human topic decisions apply only to G1 and each G2 paper topic. Other decisions use evidence-bound automated records; a legacy human_review_required report flag never supplies authority. All papers retain identical doctoral scientific-quality gates. Venue targets require at least three Q1 papers and no paper below Q2; no software can guarantee novelty, peer-review acceptance or doctoral admission.

intake.author_task: Capture only user-confirmed goals, constraints, budget, compute, schedule, application routes, exclusions and ethical boundaries. Leave unknown material facts explicit. Do not approve or advance the gate.

topic-intelligence.hard_floor: Quality schema 1.2 uses source-bound factual assessments with rationale and current source_anchors; unresolved or failed criteria block clearance, without invented 8/8.5 self-scores. Legacy numeric reports retain existing version/threshold checks and any required migration; they cannot waive current evidence; at least 5 closest primary works; at least 3 traceable databases, adjacent fields and query families; every novelty claim mapped to >=3 closest works with precise difference, falsification and residual risk; actual backward/forward citation chaining; novelty matrix 1.1 records an evidence-bound stopping_rule, retrieval_dispositions and search_rounds with honest remaining limitations; legacy 1.0 declared saturation retains its existing genuine two-round check; explicit counterevidence, doctoral synthesis and reliability strategy; automatic broad-data evidence with documented scientific-fit rejections; at least two current JCR Q1 SCI/SCIE candidate venues.
topic-intelligence.author_task: Research at least three serious topic candidates using current primary sources, adjacent literatures, patents where applicable, automatic broad-data discovery, and market/position evidence where relevant. Rank cloud-feasible directions against the actual supplied G0 weights for funded PhD supply, employment/salary, growth, PhD competition, job competition, background and application-route fit. Novelty, doctoral depth and original contribution are mandatory specific-topic requirements and cannot be traded against direction scores. Write evidence/search-log.jsonl, program/originality-audit.json, program/novelty-claim-matrix.json and program/hypothesis-register.json with source-bound differences, mechanisms, rival explanations, discriminating tests, falsification, boundaries and residual risk. During exploration keep in_progress, exploring/reopened searches, actual retained rounds, affected claims and next searches; never invent saturation, empty gaps, numeric ratings or a post-evidence discussion. Focused comparison needs its actual rationale and every focal candidate compared with every alternative; narrative evaluation can omit numerical scales. For novelty matrix 1.1, bind candidate-to-prior-work comparisons to actual retrievals and original-source anchors, retain bounded stopping reasons and unresolved limits, and obtain the existing current independent novelty assessments. Do not invent two zero-new rounds or empty gaps; legacy 1.0 retains its version-specific checks. Final G1 still requires the complete ready decision evidence and the owner's doctoral-topic decision. Preserve counterevidence, non-novel elements, rejected topics and datasets, unresolved fit risks and uncertainty. Make core A and independently evidenced extension B answer one overarching doctoral question; B remains within that topic if A fails. Only the control plane writes deterministic audits.

paper-architecture.hard_floor: Every paper must have a unique falsifiable claim, independently sufficient primary evidence, standalone scientific value, a structured originality boundary, at least two current venues meeting its declared JCR Q1/Q2 target, and a high-level experiment strategy; at least three of six papers must target Q1 and every remainder must target at least Q2; every paper pair must pass the anti-salami distinctness matrix; the portfolio must synthesize into one doctoral contribution.
paper-architecture.author_task: Build program/paper-map.json schema 2.0 and a paper-contract schema 2.0 for every configured paper. Assign at least three of six papers target_jcr_quartile=Q1 and every remainder target_jcr_quartile=Q1 or Q2; never lower scientific, originality, reliability or writing gates for Q2-targeted papers. Compare every paper pair, require different research questions and primary claims, independently sufficient evidence and standalone value, explain any shared primary outcome, state shared assets and merge triggers, and show how every paper's distinct subquestion and contribution cumulatively answer the same overarching doctoral question in thesis_synthesis. Explicitly connect each paper to core A or extension B within that one doctoral topic; shared tools, data or keywords alone are insufficient. Record each actual human paper-topic decision before advancing G2. New unexecuted portfolios then finish the active paper's G3-G5 before the next paper enters G3; G2 requires the shared architecture and high-level strategy, not all six completed experiment designs or results. Write structured research artifacts in English and reject salami slicing.

experiment-design.hard_floor: All runs require actual source rights, current data/input hashes, the original cumulative project total, a checked frozen protocol, initial/final independent audits and the native experiment runner. Missing plan.research_phase means confirmatory. Explicit exploratory protocols instead need exploration={unknown,discriminating_test,continue_if,revise_if,stop_if,claim_limit,prior_outcomes_seen}; they cannot supply confirmatory/G5 evidence. For confirmatory empirical work, the active paper needs deterministic hash-bound data quality and automated confirmation, executable statsmodels or simulation power evidence, control-plane preregistration, traceable simple/domain-standard/strong-recent baselines, fair tuning/evaluation, ablations, leakage controls, metrics, estimands, practical thresholds, effect sizes/intervals, multiplicity, >=3 stochastic seeds, robustness, negative controls, external validity, stopping/falsification rules and disjoint isolated original/replay runs with predeclared tolerances. Each run belongs to exactly one design. Actual Meta/theory uses its source-bound study protocol, outcomes or exact Lean propositions, frozen inputs and isolated replay. Never fabricate empirical data, power or baselines for another design.
experiment-design.author_task: Work on the active paper in independent execution, retaining the approved doctoral mapping. Use experiments/papers/Pxx/plan.json, budget.json and datasets.jsonl plus claims/papers/Pxx/claim-evidence.csv; sealed legacy batches retain their original paths and authority. Screen actual data rights, topical/task fit, provenance, independent units, labels, missingness, bias, leakage, version, cloud compute and external validity; preserve rejected sources and unresolved warnings. For a bounded scientific exploration, explicitly set research_phase=exploratory and declare its consequential unknown, discriminating test, continue/revise/stop conditions, claim limit and prior outcome exposure. Retain the same runner, frozen inputs, rights, cumulative budget and failed-attempt ledger; do not invent unknown power or a complete final baseline suite. Confirmatory designs retain every applicable empirical or dedicated Meta/theory requirement in references/stage-contracts.md and docs/SCIENTIFIC-STUDY-ROUTES.md. Prepare actual inputs for machine data-quality, power, preregistration and reproduction builders; the controller creates their protected reports, automated confirmations and seals without a new human stage decision. Declare prior_exploration source hashes and prior_outcomes_seen=true after actual exploration; use a separate confirmatory protocol, run IDs and output paths. Never author protected reports, signatures, executor receipts or outcomes, infer rights or fitness from metadata alone, or increase the configured project total.

experiment-execution.hard_floor: All phases require exact G3-sealed runner receipts, unchanged inputs, output hashes, retained failures/negative results and cumulative cost accounting. Checked exploratory G4 archives its actual protocol, attempts and bounded findings, then returns the same paper to G3; it cannot pass final G5 or masquerade as confirmatory evidence. For confirmatory empirical work: Quality schema 1.2 uses source-bound factual assessments with rationale and current source_anchors; unresolved or failed criteria block clearance, without invented 8/8.5 self-scores. Legacy numeric reports retain existing version/threshold checks and any required migration; they cannot waive current evidence; the active paper reproduces domain-standard and strong-recent baselines within unchanged tolerances and completes disjoint isolated replay. Reports bind frozen roles/source URLs, successful registry attempt IDs and complete current outputs, followed by protected automated reproduction confirmation. Meta/theory uses its positive source-bound study evidence, exact frozen inputs, isolated replay and automated study-validation confirmation. Deterministic checks do not certify scientific meaning.
experiment-execution.author_task: Execute only the exact sealed plan through scripts/experiment_runner.py. Preserve every attempt, immutable configuration, current output hash, adverse or inconclusive result and cost. For exploratory work, record what the discriminating observation supports and leaves unknown; the checked controller archives the round and returns this paper to G3 for a separate protocol. Do not reuse an exploratory run ID/output as confirmatory evidence. For confirmatory empirical work, build baseline-reproduction.json and clean-room-reproduction.json from exact successful attempt IDs and complete hashed outputs under the frozen baseline mappings, sources, disjoint runs, container isolation and numeric tolerances. The control plane creates protected computed evidence and current automated confirmations; models never author those files. Build the paper-scoped claim matrix and reproducibility argument without selecting favorable outcomes. Bind all comparison_ids and analysis_ids, preserve claim limits and frozen inputs, and keep interpretation subject to the existing independent audits.

writing-and-review.hard_floor: Scientific drafting cannot pass final G5. The controller reads state.writing_phases for the current paper, using the frozen contract's writing_phase only as its initial preference and otherwise defaulting to scientific. Passing scientific checks and both audits records submission for the next cycle; submission phase requires every final gate: Quality schema 1.2 uses source-bound factual assessments with rationale and current source_anchors; unresolved or failed criteria block clearance, without invented 8/8.5 self-scores. Legacy numeric reports retain existing version/threshold checks and any required migration; they cannot waive current evidence; current paper-specific JCR Q1/Q2 SCI/SCIE target with IF >1.0 and at least three Q1 papers in the portfolio; current English-language, full H/AD/CFH editorial, citation/numeric, venue, disclosure, actual render/visual and package checks; all registered outcomes locatable without direction-dependent placement; fresh initial/final independent audits with no unresolved blocking findings. The controller records the final automated decision without inventing human G5 approval.
writing-and-review.author_task: Work only on state.active_paper. In the controller's scientific writing phase, develop direct evidence-led English: the consequential problem, mechanism, strongest supported contribution, decisive comparisons, actual results and bounded implication. Keep citation/numeric/claim integrity, source-bound revision records and fresh independent initial/final scientific audits; do not require a complete editorial scorecard or venue/package pass on every scientific draft. After scientific checks and both audits pass, the controller records submission in existing state for the next G5 cycle; do not modify the frozen contract. Submission activates the complete editorial dispositions, manuscript hygiene, English-language checks, official venue/template compliance, actual rendered-file visual review, reporting checklist, disclosures and package checks in references/stage-contracts.md. Only submission can pass G5. Retain every registered result, prior exposure and true analysis phase; placement follows declared role, relevance and statistical adequacy, never result direction. Render data figures deterministically from registered data. Substantive doctoral question or paper-map changes require affected G1/G2 human decisions. A protected internal finding can request an Ixxx supplemental scope through the existing protocol review and runner; protocol-only approval cannot pass parent G5. Never invent facts, approvals, results, citations, authorship, venue status or PASS receipts; never conceal model assistance, optimize against a detector, increase the project total or submit.
